description: This file defines a controller pool for managing multiple message streaming controllers in a chat application. It provides methods to add, stop, remove, and check controllers, indexed by session and message identifiers.

methods.name: addController
methods.description: Adds a new AbortController to the pool associated with a specific session and message ID.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Aborts the streaming message controller associated with a specific session and message ID.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Aborts all message streaming controllers currently in the pool.

methods.name: hasPending
methods.description: Returns true if there are any controllers currently active in the pool.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific controller from the pool based on session and message ID.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a unique key string based on session ID and message ID to index controllers.
